notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Now Available!
notes.content:
Our newest update is now available on Steam!

Patch 1.0.3 is a smaller incremental patch that introduces a brand new Dungeon theme, complete with an OST piece, and three new exclusive unlockable skins to Season matchmaking and a rematch option for all online play modes!

Thank you for your support! We hope you're enjoying Treasure Stack and would welcome you to join our Discord server to say hi and give us some feedback!

https://discord.gg/jp2U3xc

notes.title: Season 2 and Patch 1.0.2 are Live!
notes.content:
Season 2 of ranked multiplayer is now live alongside new season rewards featuring a trio of unlikely rogues! 

Patch Notes 1.0.2

QOL Improvements

- Option to return directly to matchmaking after an online game.
- Tips (multiplayer queue) cycle every 15 seconds for better distribution.
- High scores added to Solo Play.
- Crown element on ranked post game screen now represents highest score in any given match instead of personal best score in ranked mode.
- Interstitional loading screens recolored to black.
- Various visual fixes to UI in post game loading screen.
- Adjusted targeting to be more responsive.

Online Adjustments

- Ranked ladder has been effectively cut in half. Each tier (Peasant, Bronze, Silver, Gold) will now have 5 levels instead of 10.
- Matchmaking logic has been expanded to search within current tier and fallback to any user in queue to decrease wait times. The logic was too strict at launch to support the player base.
- Earn XP towards unlocks in Ranked and Casual online modes!!!
- New background for MP queue screen.
- Win and loss indicators now have context in ranked mode.

Solo Play Features

- Chest drop speed can now be modified for faster start speeds and less early game downtime.
- Demon runes (junk) spawn rate can now be halved or turned off altogether with rewards adjusted accordingly. Players will earn 50% of their total score when junk spawn has been halved and won’t earn any when disabled.
- Personal best score will now be displayed when choosing solo play.
- XP progress towards next chest will now be a persistent UI element displayed on main menu.

Local Party Features

- Earn XP points towards unlocks in Local Party! The player with the highest score at the end of a game has their points going towards unlocks.
- Chest drop speed can now be modified for faster start speeds and less early game downtime.
- Demon runes (junk) spawn rate can now be halved or turned off altogether with rewards adjusted accordingly. Players will earn 50% of their total score when junk spawn has been halved and won’t earn any when disabled.
